site_name: Apartment 16, Sloane Building, Hortensia Road, LONDON, SW10 0HF
description: Internal alterations, including removal of non-original partitioning and rearrangement of the kitchen; infill of a non-original door and making good of walls from the communal corridor into flat; alteration of non-original partitioning and non-original staircase to principal bedroom en-suite bathroom and dressing room; alteration of non-original wall-nibs to principal bedroom lobby; alteration of non-original staircase to non-original mezzanine level above kitchen; removal of a non-original fireplace from main reception room; installation of a small demountable raised area within main reception room; installation of a demountable framed glass wall and doors to original staircase and installation of a demountable partition and door to form a cupboard at second floor mezzanine. (retrospective application)
